newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded, diesel prices firm.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded, diesel prices firm.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline and diesel fuel basis firmed on Tuesday on steady differentials and stronger front-month futures prices.

Diesel and jet/kero prices were expected to come under pressure on American Petroleum Institute's report of a 1.72 million barrel build in distillate stocks in the PADD II Midwest refining region, traders said.
The weekly API estimates showed Midwest refiners have trimmed gasoline runs in favor of distillate production, with gasoline output down a net 105,000 barrels on the week.
Midwest refineries were operating at 96.3 percent of capacity, down 0.9 percentage points due in part to scattered outages and turnarounds.
Unleaded differentials were unchanged in Chicago at 0.75/1.0 cent over the print for prompt deliveries and 0.75/1.0 cent under for later deliveries.
Group Three unleaded remained 1.0/1.25 cent over the print for prompt deliveries and 0.75/0.50 cent under for later deliveries.
Low sulphur and high sulphur diesel differentials were unchanged in both markets, and jet/kero was steady in Chicago and Group Three.
